records.text: I took some of your sons as prophets and some of your young men for consecration. Are these things not so, sons of Israel?” says the Lord.
The Lord your God shall raise up unto you a prophet from among your brethren, like unto me; you shall hearken unto him,

triples.relationship: divine appointment of prophets from within the people
triples.rationale: Amos recalls God taking some of the people's sons as prophets, alongside young men for consecration. Deuteronomy promises a prophet raised by the Lord from among their brothers. Both place prophetic appointment with God and its human origin within the people, while taking and raising remain the respective verbs.
